AddComment.description: Adds a comment to the current slide.

params.description: The X position (in EMU) of the comment (defaults to 0).
params.name: posX

params.description: The Y position (in EMU) of the comment (defaults to 0).
params.name: posY

params.description: The comment text.
params.name: text

params.description: The author's name (defaults to the current user name).
params.name: author

params.description: The user ID of the comment author (defaults to the current user ID).
params.name: userId

AddComment.signature: AddComment(posX: number, posY: number, text: string, author?: string, userId?: string): boolean

AddNotesText.description: Adds a text to the notes page of the current slide.

params.description: The text to be added to the notes page.
params.name: sText

returns.description: Returns true if text was added successfully, otherwise false.

AddObject.description: Adds an object (image, shape or chart) to the current presentation slide.

params.description: The object which will be added to the current presentation slide.
params.name: oDrawing

returns.description: returns false if slide doesn't exist.

ApplyLayout.description:
Applies the specified layout to the current slide.
The layout must be in slide master.

params.description: Layout to be applied.
params.name: oLayout

returns.description: returns false if slide doesn't exist.

ApplyTheme.description: Applies the specified theme to the current slide.

params.description: Presentation theme.
params.name: oApiTheme

returns.description: returns false if master is null or master hasn't background.
return false if slide doesn't exist.

Copy.description: Creates a copy of the current slide object.

returns.description: returns new ApiSlide object that represents the duplicate slide. Returns null if slide doesn't exist.

Delete.description: Deletes the current slide from the presentation.

returns.description: returns false if slide doesn't exist or is not in the presentation.

Duplicate.description: Creates a duplicate of the specified slide object, adds the new slide to the slides collection.

params.description: Position where the new slide will be added.
params.name: nPos

returns.description: returns new ApiSlide object that represents the duplicate slide. Returns null if slide doesn't exist or is not in the presentation.

FollowLayoutBackground.description: Sets the layout background as the background of the slide.

returns.description: returns false if layout is null or layout hasn't background or slide doesn't exist.

FollowMasterBackground.description: Sets the master background as the background of the slide.

returns.description: returns false if master is null or master hasn't background or slide doesn't exist.

GetAllCharts.description: Returns an array with all the chart objects from the slide.

GetAllDrawings.description: Returns an array with all the drawing objects from the slide.

GetAllImages.description: Returns an array with all the image objects from the slide.

GetAllOleObjects.description: Returns an array with all the OLE objects from the slide.

GetAllShapes.description: Returns an array with all the shape objects from the slide.

GetAllTables.description: Returns an array with all tables from the current slide.

returns.description: An array with all tables from the current slide.

GetBackground.description: Returns the background fill of the current presentation slide.

returns.description: returns null if the slide doesn't exist or has no background fill.

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiSlide class.

GetDrawingsByPlaceholderType.description: Returns an array of drawings by the specified placeholder type.

params.description: The placeholder type.
params.name: sType

GetHeight.description: Returns the slide height in English measure units.

GetLayout.description: Returns a layout of the current slide.

returns.description: returns null if slide or layout doesn't exist.

GetNotesPage.description: Returns the notes page from the current slide.

GetSlideIndex.description: Returns a position of the current slide in the presentation.

returns.description: returns -1 if slide doesn't exist or is not in the presentation.

GetSlideShowTransition.description: Returns the slide show transition of the current slide.

returns.description: Returns the slide show transition or null if the slide has no transition.

GetTheme.description: Returns a theme of the current slide.

returns.description: returns null if slide or layout or master or theme doesn't exist.

GetTimeLine.description: Returns the animation timeline for the slide.

returns.description: The animation timeline for the slide.

GetVisible.description: Returns the visibility of the current presentation slide.

GetWidth.description: Returns the slide width in English measure units.

GroupDrawings.description: Groups an array of drawings in the current slide.

params.description: An array of drawings to group.
params.name: aDrawings

MoveTo.description: Moves the current slide to a specific location within the same collection.

params.description: Position where the current slide will be moved to.
params.name: nPos

returns.description: returns false if slide doesn't exist or position is invalid or slide is not in the presentation.

RemoveAllObjects.description: Removes all the objects from the current slide.

RemoveObject.description: Removes objects (image, shape or chart) from the current slide.

params.description: Position from which the object will be deleted.
params.name: nPos

params.description: The number of elements to delete.
params.name: nCount

returns.description: returns false if slide doesn't exist or position is invalid or slide hasn't objects.

Search.description: Searches for the specified text within the current slide and returns all found occurrences as text ranges.

params.description: The text to search for.
params.name: text

params.description: Case sensitive or not.
params.name: isMatchCase

params.description: Whether to search for whole words only.
params.name: isWholeWords

Search.signature: Search(text: string, isMatchCase?: boolean, isWholeWords?: boolean): ApiTextRange[]

SetBackground.description: Sets the background to the current presentation slide.

params.description: The color or pattern used to fill the presentation slide background.
params.name: oApiFill

SetSlideShowTransition.description: Sets the slide show transition to the current slide.

params.description: The slide show transition to be applied.
params.name: transition

returns.description: Returns true if the transition was applied successfully, otherwise false.

SetVisible.description: Sets the visibility to the current presentation slide.

params.description: Slide visibility.
params.name: value

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiSlide object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies if the slide layout will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteLayout

params.description: Specifies if the slide master will be written to the JSON object or not (bWriteMaster is false if bWriteLayout === false).
params.name: bWriteMaster

params.description: Specifies if all child layouts from the slide master will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteAllMasLayouts

params.description: Specifies whether to write used table styles to the JSON object (true) or not (false).
params.name: bWriteTableStyles

ToJSON.signature: ToJSON(bWriteLayout?: boolean, bWriteMaster?: boolean, bWriteAllMasLayouts?: boolean, bWriteTableStyles?: boolean): object
